experiment: XFIN: AT-Trunk with its 40 BatchNorm2d layers replaced by full-channel InstanceNorm2d (same channel counts, affine, no running statistics); the R3 loss, the fp32 training path, the cosine floor 2e-8, seed 0 and every other setting are exactly those of XF

baseline_reference.comparison_rule: compare with XF seed 0 only (same seed, loss, precision, floor); the three-seed AMP AT-Trunk baseline is NOT the primary comparison; all Val-A numbers are exploratory

data.manifest_scope: ONLY the train and val_A manifests are hashed / loaded; val_B, val and val_clean are removed from train_v2.MANIFESTS before train_v2.main() runs; UIEB is never referenced

loss.implementation: original_repo/marine_net_model.py :: MARINELoss (unchanged, SHA-256 pinned) via train_v2.build exactly as for the AT-Trunk R3 runs: train_v2.FinalOutputLoss (auxiliary L1 terms fed the target, exactly 0) and train_v2.ZeroLoss for the weight-0.0 perceptual term
loss.clamp: pred and target are clamped to [0,1] inside the loss; AT-Trunk's output is already clamped inside the model, so this is identical to the AT-Trunk R3 runs
loss.precision: fp32 forward and fp32 loss (amp False, no GradScaler); convolution TF32 is left at the PyTorch default and recorded under 'runtime'
loss.non_finite_guard: train_v2.step is replaced by the reviewed XR guarded_step wrapped by a recorder: clip_grad_norm_ as before, a non-finite total norm raises FloatingPointError BEFORE optimizer.step (train_v2.step would step with NaN gradients under fp32)
loss.r3_internal_nan_guards: MARINELoss replaces a non-finite term by a constant; that masking is part of the R3 definition and is NOT altered; the driver and gate additionally stop on non-finite gradient norms

clip_logging.clipped_means: clip_grad_norm_ rescaled the gradient (scale = min(1, clip / (norm + 1e-6)) < 1)
clip_logging.note: observation only: the recorder reads the pre-clip norm that the step already returns; no training arithmetic is changed; no earlier run logged this, so there is no baseline fraction

unchanged: AT-Trunk architecture, output clamp, initialisation and parameter count
train_v2 training loop, optimizer AdamW, warm-up 3, clip 1.0, batch 4, lr 2e-4, 100 epochs
paired horizontal flips only, same data and data order for seed 0
frozen evaluator train_v2.evaluate and Val-A best-PSNR selection
remaining_confounders: mechanism: the swap removes batch coupling and the train / eval statistics mismatch AND adds per-image channel normalisation; one run cannot tell which one acts

full-channel InstanceNorm2d on all 40 sites, unlike WWE-UIE's half-channel InstanceNorm2d on 10 layers: the result does not transfer to WWE-UIE's design, and WWE-UIE's remaining differences stay bundled

global colour head: it reads the mean-pooled bottleneck (at_marine.py:171) and the grid head the pooled bottleneck (:174); instance normalisation zeroes the per-image channel mean of every block BRANCH, so colour-cast information must reach the heads through the unnormalised stem and the residual skips; the experiment cannot exclude that this costs accuracy (the result would show it only as a lower PSNR)
numerics: InstanceNorm2d in the fp32 path (this is why XF, not the AMP baseline, is the reference); the fp32 convolutions may use TF32 (PyTorch default, recorded in xfin_loss_config.json)

one seed: the AT-Trunk R3 seeds span 0.41 dB; cuDNN is not bitwise deterministic, so the same seed does not reproduce XF exactly; Val-A selects the checkpoint (best-epoch selection inflates noisy curves)
the reference is XF seed 0 only (28.501 / 28.384); the three-seed AMP baseline is NOT the primary comparison

decision_rule.ssim: SSIM at the best epoch minus 0.9338
decision_rule.classes: supports_in_helps: both PSNR deltas >= +0.5, SSIM drop <= 0.005, no non-finite step; weakens_in_hypothesis: both deltas <= +0.3; otherwise inconclusive. Practical thresholds, not significance tests; one seed excludes only a large effect.

code.untracked_dependency_note: original_repo/ is git-ignored; its SHA-256 is pinned in xr_config and re-verified before launch, while training, after training and in the gate

normalisation: 40 x InstanceNorm2d(c, affine, no running statistics)

normalisation.initialisation: construction and random-number use identical to ATMarineTrunk(); BatchNorm2d and InstanceNorm2d both start at weight 1 / bias 0 without drawing random numbers, so all convolution / linear parameters are bit-identical for the same seed
